quotes: The impediment to action advances action. What stands in the way becomes the way.||Marcus Aurelius
Avoiding what scares you teaches your brain it was dangerous.
Facing it in small steps teaches your brain you're safe.
Name the feeling out loud. Naming it takes some of its power.
posts.caption:
What blocks you can become your path. 🧭

Marcus Aurelius, Meditations 5.20 (Hays translation). Then the modern view: avoidance keeps fear alive, small exposures and naming feelings calm it. General psychology ideas, not medical advice.

quotes: Waste no more time arguing what a good man should be. Be one.||Marcus Aurelius
posts.caption:
Stop debating it. Become it. 🌿

Marcus Aurelius, Meditations 10.16 (Hays translation).

quotes: We suffer more often in imagination than in reality.||Seneca
You can't think your way out of a feeling your body still holds.
Slow your exhale. A calmer body gives you a clearer mind.
Rumination feels like problem-solving, but it keeps you stuck.
posts.caption:
Most of our storms start in our heads. 🌊

Seneca, Letters to Lucilius 13 (Gummere translation). Then what psychology adds about the body and rumination. General psychology ideas, not medical advice.

quotes: A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.||Lao Tzu
posts.caption:
Just take the step. 🥾

Lao Tzu, Tao Te Ching, chapter 64 (translations vary).
